Description: Supplementary phenotypic/task-log table linking participants, BIDS session labels, task identifiers, scan dates, and corresponding task-fMRI BOLD files. This table is not intended to be a complete scan inventory; it only covers task-fMRI entries with available external scan-date records and may not include T1w or resting-state acquisitions.
IntendedFor: Task-fMRI date tracking and quality-control linkage. For complete per-session scan inventories, use session-level *_scans.tsv files.

task_id.Description: Task identifier corresponding to the BIDS task entity in the associated BOLD filename. Values are stored with the task- prefix in this table.

session_id.Description: BIDS session identifier matching the session directory and filename entity. In this dataset, session labels encode the local acquisition/session scheme. For example, labels such as ses-101 or ses-202 should be interpreted according to the dataset-specific coding rule.

scan_date.Description: Calendar date on which the corresponding task-fMRI scan was acquired, derived from the external scan/task date log.
scan_date.Format: YYYY/M/D in the current table; YYYY-MM-DD is recommended for a normalized BIDS release.

bold_path.Description: Path to the corresponding task-fMRI BOLD NIfTI file. For data sharing or long-term BIDS organization, paths relative to the BIDS root are recommended instead of absolute local Windows paths.

Notes: This phenotype table does not require entries for anatomical T1w or resting-state fMRI files unless scan-date records for those acquisitions are available and intentionally added.
